;mode800
; ======================================================================
;  ハヤシ迷作劇場  ONScripter / Ponscripter runtime
;  Generated by Converter\svs_to_ons.py (template: Converter\ons_runtime.txt).
;  Variable map: %0-%174 story flags (V101[n]), %179 choice result,
;  %190-%199 scratch, %300- persistent V101[n>=175], %400- V108 flags (CG unlock),
;  %500- other scratch values, $1 protagonist name.
;  Movie / CM registers: %125 %126 CM numbers of a game (V101[125] V101[126]), %186 CM to play,
;  %187 variant, %188 number of CMs, $92 movie file.
; ======================================================================
*define
caption "ハヤシ迷作劇場"
savenumber 20
globalon
rmenu "セーブ",save,"ロード",load,"スキップ",skip,"リセット",reset
defsub s_nm
defsub s_textoff
defsub s_bg
defsub s_chr
defsub s_chr2
defsub s_chr_clear
defsub s_chr_reset
defsub s_fadein
defsub s_fadeout
defsub s_quake
defsub s_flash
defsub s_select
defsub s_movie
game

*start
; setwindow is a program block command (it crashes the engine inside *define)
setwindow 40,440,31,5,22,22,0,6,20,0,1,":a;window.png",16,400
mov $1,"ピーター"
goto *title

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- title
*title
bgmstop
bg "title01.bmp",10,800
bgm "music\M01TITLE.ogg"
select "はじめから",*new_game,"ロード",*title_load

*title_load
systemcall load
goto *title

*new_game
bgmstop
mov %64,0
mov %80,0
mov %130,0
; %65 = 0: the first eye catch is followed by the second CM (see eye.spr)
mov %65,0
;@@MOVIE_OP@@
gosub *s_cm_pick
mov %186,%125
gosub *s_cm_play
goto *s_chapter

; Chapter dispatch, taken from name.spr (chapter %64, route %130) and save.spr (ending by %130).
; Every converted script jumps here when it reaches the end of its code.
*s_chapter
if %64==0 goto *mei01_start
if %64==1 goto *mei02_start
if %64==2 goto *mei03_start
if %64==3 && %130==0 goto *mei04_1_start
if %64==3 && %130==1 goto *mei04_2_start
if %64==4 && %130==0 goto *mei05_1_start
if %64==4 && %130==1 goto *mei05_2_start
if %64==5 && %130==0 goto *mei06_1_start
if %64==5 && %130==1 goto *mei06_2_start
if %64==5 && %130==2 goto *mei06_3_start
if %64==6 && %130==0 goto *mei07_1_start
if %64==6 && %130==1 goto *mei07_2_start
if %64==6 && %130==2 goto *mei07_3_start
if %64>=7 && %130==0 goto *ed1_start
if %64>=7 && %130==1 goto *ed2_start
if %64>=7 && %130==2 goto *ed3_start
if %64>=7 && %130==3 goto *ed4_start
if %64>=7 && %130==4 goto *ed5_start
goto *title

; next.spr (chapter preview and save prompt) is not converted; it only advances the chapter.
; Leaving the last chapter (%64 becomes 7) plays the ending movie.
*s_next_preview
add %64,1
if %64!=7 return
;@@MOVIE_ED@@
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- movies
; The movies are MPEG-1 (video\*.mov converted by tools\mov_to_mpg.py). A click or Esc skips them.
; s_movie file
*s_movie
getparam $92
bgmstop
csp -1
cl a,0
textoff
mov %6,-1
mov %7,-1
bg black,1
mpegplay $92,1
bg black,1
return

; CMs: %125 / %126 hold the CM numbers of a game (1..%188, picked by the engine like op.spr does),
; the first one is played after the opening, the second one between the first two eye catches.
*s_cm_pick
mov %125,0
mov %126,0
;@@CMCOUNT@@
if %188<=0 return
rnd %125,%188
add %125,1
if %188<2 return
*s_cm_pick2
rnd %126,%188
add %126,1
if %126==%125 goto *s_cm_pick2
return

; s_cm_play: plays the CM whose number is in %186 (0 = none)
*s_cm_play
if %186<=0 return
gosub *s_cmfile
s_movie $92
return

; %186 = CM number (and %187 = which of its movies) -> $92
*s_cmfile
;@@CMFILE@@
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- name plate
*s_textoff
csp 900
textoff
return

*s_nm
getparam $90
if $90=="" csp 900:return
mov $91,":s/20,20,0;#ffffff"
mov $91,$91+$90
lsp 900,$91,52,408
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- background
*s_bg
getparam $90,%180
bg $90,0
gosub *s_chr_draw
if %180<=0 print 1:return
print 10,%180
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- characters
; state: %6 left/only character, %7 right character, %8/%9 their expressions,
;        %5 slot that was changed last, -1 = empty
*s_chrfile
;@@CHRFILE@@
return

*s_chr_draw
cl a,0
if %6<0 && %7<0 return
if %6>=0 && %7<0 goto *s_cd_one
if %6>=0 && %7>=0 goto *s_cd_two
mov %190,%7
mov %191,%9
gosub *s_chrfile
ld r,$90,0
return
*s_cd_one
mov %190,%6
mov %191,%8
gosub *s_chrfile
ld c,$90,0
return
*s_cd_two
mov %190,%6
mov %191,%8
gosub *s_chrfile
ld l,$90,0
mov %190,%7
mov %191,%9
gosub *s_chrfile
ld r,$90,0
return

*s_chr_reset
cl a,0
return

; s_chr mode,fade,expression,character   (mode 1 = hide the character)
*s_chr
getparam %180,%181,%182,%183
if %180==1 goto *s_chr_hide
if %6<0 && %7<0 goto *s_chr_first
if %7<0 goto *s_chr_one
if %6==%183 mov %8,%182:mov %5,0:goto *s_chr_go
if %7==%183 mov %9,%182:mov %5,1:goto *s_chr_go
if %5==0 mov %7,%183:mov %9,%182:mov %5,1:goto *s_chr_go
mov %6,%183
mov %8,%182
mov %5,0
goto *s_chr_go
*s_chr_first
mov %6,%183
mov %8,%182
mov %5,0
goto *s_chr_go
*s_chr_one
if %6==%183 mov %8,%182:goto *s_chr_go
mov %7,%183
mov %9,%182
mov %5,1
goto *s_chr_go
*s_chr_hide
if %6==%183 mov %6,%7:mov %8,%9:mov %7,-1
if %7==%183 mov %7,-1
goto *s_chr_go

; s_chr2 fade,right expression,right character,left expression,left character
*s_chr2
getparam %185,%181,%182,%183,%184
mov %6,%184
mov %8,%183
mov %7,%182
mov %9,%181
mov %5,1
mov %181,%185
goto *s_chr_go

*s_chr_clear
getparam %181
mov %6,-1
mov %7,-1
*s_chr_go
gosub *s_chr_draw
if %181>0 print 10,300:return
print 1
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- fades
*s_fadeout
getparam %180,%181
; w.bmp / b.bmp are 800x600 solid white / black pictures from the game data.
; ":c;" = no transparency, ":a;" = use the alpha channel of the PNG (the default would key out the top-left colour)
if %181==1 lsp 999,":c;w.bmp",0,0
if %181!=1 lsp 999,":c;b.bmp",0,0
if %180<=0 print 1
if %180>0 print 10,%180
mov %6,-1
mov %7,-1
cl a,0
return

*s_fadein
getparam %180,%181
csp 999
if %180<=0 print 1:return
print 10,%180
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- effects
*s_quake
quakey 6,300
return

*s_flash
lsp 998,":c;w.bmp",0,0
print 1
wait 60
csp 998
print 10,250
return

; ------------------------------------------------------- choices
; The original choices are timed: when nobody answers, the result is "number of options + 1".
*s_select
getparam %178,%174
btndef clear
;@@SELECTJUMP@@
return

;@@SELECT@@

*s_sel_wait
print 10,300
btntime %174
*s_sel_loop
btnwait %179
; -1 = right click (the menu was handled), -2/-5/0 = time out, 1.. = button
if %179==-1 goto *s_sel_loop
if %179>0 goto *s_sel_done
mov %179,%177
add %179,1
*s_sel_done
mov %176,301
mov %175,301
add %175,%177
*s_sel_clr
csp %176
add %176,1
if %176<%175 goto *s_sel_clr
print 10,200
return

; ====================================================================
;  Converted scripts
; ====================================================================
